*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Donbas (2022–present)|Battle of Donbas]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] shell [[Lyman, Ukraine|Lyman]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], killing eight people and injuring 13 others, according to [[Governor of Donetsk Oblast|governor]] [[Pavlo Kyrylenko]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-66142752 (BBC News)]

**Four [[insurgent]]s and two officers are killed at a [[police station]] in [[Zahedan]], [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202307082943 (Iran International)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Farewell Yellow Brick Road]]
**English musician [[Elton John]], the fourth [[List of best-selling music artists|best-selling music artist of all time]], performs his final concert at the [[Tele2 Arena]] in [[Stockholm]], [[Sweden]], after [[Concert tour|touring]] for more than 50 years. [https://globalnews.ca/news/9821144/elton-john-last-show-stockholm-concert-video/ (Global News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Murrieta plane crash]]
**A [[plane crash]]es in [[Murrieta, California|Murrieta]], [[California]], [[United States]], killing all six people aboard. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/tylerroush/2023/07/08/6-killed-in-southern-california-plane-crash-second-deadly-crash-in-a-week/ (''Forbes'')]
